criteria.requirement: Read-only by design: cannot write back to any source system
criteria.detail: Synthetic source records remain immutable through all five local changes; the UI states that changes affect only the analysis copy, and the baseline remains SYN-21 r1. The application has no source-system write or network path. — demonstrated by all-risk-evidence at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Every flagged risk explains itself and traces to source records
criteria.detail: Every flagged synthetic timing risk explains its causal prerequisite chain, finish and margin and resolves to its actual supporting source records. Both final flags show record IDs, revisions and exact excerpts; no unresolved source may support a flag. — demonstrated by all-risk-evidence at both viewport sizes.

The analyst must acknowledge advisory synthetic analysis to record review; missing acknowledgment preserves the note and blocks review. Recorded review and exported brief require human decisions and execute no operational action. — demonstrated by human-brief, review-recovery at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Works on last-synced data; synthetic data only
criteria.detail: Bundled snapshots and local saved-session restoration are planned, but no source ingestion, synchronization or verified last-synced lifecycle exists. Synthetic-only is enforced; the full last-synced requirement remains unverified.

criteria.requirement: Fleet-Ready Definition of Done (all solutions): runs offline; keeps humans in authority; cites sources; logs auditable actions; syncs on reconnect; includes a one-page path to fleet.
criteria.detail: Offline local operation, advisory review, citations, local review log and path-to-fleet.md are planned slices. Authenticated source synchronization, operational audit assurances and the full Fleet-Ready composite are outside this synthetic-only boundary; remain unverified.

criteria.requirement: Identify the controlling path and deadline margin.
criteria.detail: The known radar path Parts → Repair → Radar test finishes day 9 with margin 12 at deadline 21. A casualty increases finish to 12 and margin to 9; a part delay increases finish to 23 and margin to -2. Watch qualification initially finishes day 7 with margin 14. — demonstrated by known-path at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Never convert missing estimates to zero.
criteria.detail: A blank repair duration becomes null and makes radar finish and margin UNKNOWN with only a lower-bound path, while watch finish stays 7. Restoring duration 3 yields radar finish 9 and margin 12. No missing prerequisite duration becomes a known zero. — demonstrated by unknown-recovery at both viewport sizes.

A cycle blocks analysis with a cycle diagnostic; a missing-task dependency blocks analysis identifying repair and missing-task. Neither leaves stale results presented as current. Restoring the valid model yields finish 9 and margin 12. — demonstrated by invalid-graph-recovery at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Validate the model with the operational owner.
criteria.detail: No operational owner approval or SME-reviewed baseline is supplied. Planner arithmetic and toolkit calculations do not establish model validation.

criteria.requirement: Injected risks correctly identified and ranked against an answer key
criteria.detail: A five-change illustrative scenario and deterministic timing results are planned, but approved risk semantics, ranking policy and independent SME answer key are absent. No mission risk-ranking accuracy claim.

A benign metadata event can demonstrate unchanged arithmetic in Node tests, but there is no approved labeled noise corpus or acceptable threshold. A local zero-noise or single-case check cannot satisfy this evaluation.

criteria.requirement: Every flagged risk traceable to its source records
criteria.detail: All two final flagged synthetic risks have inspectable source records: radar cites parts r2, casualty r1, maintenance r2, test r1 and schedule r2; watch cites manning r2, qualification r1 and schedule r2. Exact supporting excerpts and model links are retained. — demonstrated by all-risk-evidence at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Time to produce a leadership readiness brief against a manual baseline [baseline to be set with Fleet SME]
criteria.detail: Local brief generation is planned, but no Fleet SME baseline, timing endpoints or comparison protocol exists. Application timing is not evidence of time savings.

criteria.requirement: Official judging rubric: Warfighting 30%; Speed to Fleet 20%; Scalability 20%; Barrier Removal 15%; Judges' Discretion 15%.
criteria.detail: Only authorized human judges can assess the official rubric. No automated score or judging outcome is planned.

criteria.requirement: Earlier identification of compounding readiness risks
criteria.detail: The synthetic five-event sequence exposes timing changes before an illustrative deadline; approved capability links, a reviewed scenario and operational earlier-warning evidence are missing. Timing is not mission readiness.

The brief offers illustrative considerations ordered by known target margin, with unknowns separated; priority policy and response-option correctness have not been owner validated. Full leadership action prioritization stays unverified.
A reproducible local synthetic brief is planned, but there is no manual baseline or study establishing reduced assembly time.
